business_rules.title: Products are immutable after creation
business_rules.statement: Product records (and document versions) are frozen at creation — immutable at type and runtime level.

business_rules.title: DD project gate state machine
business_rules.statement: Design & Development projects advance through gates: draft→in_review→work_proposal→execution→outcome→completed (or closed_no_go).

business_rules.title: SKU is a documented surrogate
business_rules.statement: `sku` is a domain-view surrogate with no persisted ERD column (allow-listed in endpoint-parity).

business_rules.title: Genocode authority (redesign)
business_rules.statement: Genocode should be the canonical product/strain authority unifying the legacy models (Seam 4). Redesign pending.

connectors.name: Seam 4 — Genocode / product master authority
connectors.effect: Genocode is the authority; product-master unifies the legacy batch.Product + SpecProduct models
